Legal Grounds
10. That the Defendant's demand for price escalation is illegal and void. While Clause 3-3 of

tte General Terms and ('onditions allows tbr price adjustments due to increases in material
costs betrveen the signing date and the Completion Date, such a provision cannot be
invoked to benefit the I)eveloper for clelays caused by its o'*'n failure to meet the agreed
cie-adline of 30 June 201-1.

rI

t\4.

0?i

.t,{

11.

That the "Completion Date" for the purpose of price fixing must be the contractually agreed
di:te of 30.Iune 2024. An1'escalation in costs occurring afterthis date is solely'due to the

Defendant's breach of contract and cannot be shifted onto the Plaintiff.

12. That the Defendant is stopped by its own conduct from claiming any increase in cost. as it
f

ailed to deliver the Units on time. Allowing the Defendant to charge escalation for a period

ot its orm default would amount to rewarding a breach of contract.
13. E';en otherwise and the above without prejudice, price adjustments (escalation) duc to

increases in material costs etc. has to be proved and its impact on the Defendant and the

c()rresponding cost'on the Plaintiff has to be established through verifiable evidence.

c.4

which the Plaintiff is not entitled to any escalation whatsoever. Also. the Defendant
tled to claim anl. LIS$ vs PKR cxchange rate variation. rvhich has nothing to do

uith

lrJ

colorable exercise of poiver and a violation of the Agreements.

15. That the cause of action arose when the Defendant failed to deliver the Units by 30 June

2)21. and subsequentll' when it issued the illegal demands for price revision on 20
Fcbruary 2025, and the flnal reminders on 24February 2026. The cause of action is still
c,)ntinuing.
